// Fixture for tests/sql-identifier-safety.test.mjs — proves the alias auditor
// fires. Deliberately contains ONE unsafe alias plus the shapes it must NOT
// flag, so a regression in the filters shows up as a count mismatch.
const q = `SELECT so2.id AS soId2,
                  di.qty AS qty,
                  x.created_at AS createdAt,
                  CAST(v AS INTEGER) AS n
             FROM t`;
// AS soIgnored -- a comment, must not count
const ae = `SELECT blob2 AS routeName FROM hookka_erp_metrics`;
const cte = `WITH recent AS (SELECT 1)`;
